jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Isolated modular pixel-art architecture source for GRIMSPIRE, matching the supplied native kit and gothic North Star. TRUE transparent background. NO environment, sky, ground, water, cast shadow, glow, text or people. Strict flat FRONT ELEVATION for 2D side-scrolling terrain: no perspective, no visible side wall. Crisp broad pixel clusters, large dark masonry courses, restrained broad fractures, no tiny speckles. Six neutral stone values #11161d #191f28 #232a34 #2e3641 #3b434f #4c5460. No bright highlights, no coloured rims, no gradients. Optional window glass only is solid flat magenta #cf286d without bloom. Complete module visible with clear margin. All holes and open arches are truly transparent. Robust stone, no delicate filigree. K05 BRIDGE SPAN, target180×80 art pixels, aspect2.25:1. A horizontal flat walkable deck with low gothic stone balustrade above, ONE large open pointed arch underneath. Strong pointed arch curve, heavy wedge stones, sturdy square end blocks. The arch opens through the bottom, no floor beneath it. Left and right edges match in height/profile so two spans tile horizontally; no decorative end towers. No support piers extending below module. Deck lies about20 art pixels down from top; below is60 pixels of arch.
